scope: Reviewed assets and runtime sources carried by this public polish candidate.

weather.location: The public Rochester airport observation station, representing regional weather.
weather.delivery: Requested by the visitor browser, with no household proxy, household coordinate or geolocation.
weather.privacy: The fixed public station identifier is the only application location sent. Ordinary browser and network metadata reaches the National Weather Service. The FellowSoft application adds no analytics or visitor log.
weather.attribution: Field weather by the National Weather Service
weather.rightsBasis: NWS observations are open data, free to use for any purpose. The field derives an illustrative atmosphere from those observations.

imageFamilies.origin: Project-controlled FellowSoft atmospheric paintings. The matching CSS files embed those exact WebP bytes for first paint.
Previously reviewed North Hollow share card.
imageFamilies.privacy: Invented preview household; no resident records.

imageFamilies.origin: Fresh October 8 software captures of the invented North Hollow household.
imageFamilies.privacy: No real resident records. Arcade shows blank cartridge placeholders; Watch shows authored fictional catalogue entries; weather uses invented conditions. Phone is a browser layout, not a physical-device photograph.
imageFamilies.transform: Crop, proportional resize and quiet device edge on paper; no UI retouching; no metadata copied.

imageFamilies.origin: Fresh October 8 captures of the Work browser demonstration with the fictional company Parasol Labs.
imageFamilies.privacy: All company and employee data shown is fictional.

imageFamilies.origin: Preserved software capture of the native Stub Book home screen, reviewed October 8.
imageFamilies.privacy: Four home panes only. No game, ROM or game list. No new physical-device qualification is implied.

imageFamilies.origin: Rendered directly from the project-controlled canonical glass painter.

type.delivery: Five same-origin font files. The two front faces also travel embedded in the document head so their first use cannot reset the text. No font service is contacted.
type.source: Official Fontsource 5.3.0 packages; Latin WOFF2 members copied unchanged.

browserState.intro: One session-only flag remembers whether the arrival animation has played. It contains no identity or visit log.
browserState.instrument: The Stubbook runs locally in a sandboxed frame, synthesizes its own music, and makes no network request.
browserState.specimen: The public compiler and curated PlainLedger runtime operate in memory. The specimen calls no model, network or persistent storage. Reloading clears its visitor-entered rows.
